title: Fabric Inbox agent event — data.value (B-118)
description: What a reply agent did with one incoming message, as the agent-events feed carries it (list_agent_events; fabric-service/0.1 events page, data.value). Never the sender, the subject or any message text: the question is the model's paraphrase, written without personal data.

runId.description: The run; list_agent_runs runId reads it

address.description: The agent address the message was sent to

intent.description: One or two words for what the sender wanted

grounded.description: Every fact in the answer came from the agent's knowledge or tools

unanswered.description: The knowledge had no confident answer, or the answer could not be grounded

question.description: Only when unanswered: what the person wanted to know, paraphrased in English without personal data

sources.description: Titles of the passages the agent was given

topic.description: What the message is about, in two to four English words (the model's label, personal details removed)

summary.description: What the sender wants, as one English sentence without personal data

category.description: The agent policy's category of the message (the model picks one of the policy's list).

handoff.description: Answered with the policy's hand-off reply: a person handles it (event kind agent.handoff).

fallback.description: Answered with the policy's fixed safe reply: nothing confident could be said.

dissatisfied.description: The message replies to an earlier answer and says it did not help (event kind agent.not_helped); reported to the knowledge tool as an outdated gap.

waitingHours.description: The message has waited this many whole hours for a person past the SLA of 4 hours: held or drafted (event kind agent.waiting, sent once per run; B-131).

closed.description: The message's second agent.waiting (B-141): its retries ended after 30 days without an answer.

closingSent.description: With closed: a fixed closing reply naming another route was sent (the policy's closingReply, else the default apology and its hand-off reply).
